leads.reason: Part of a tight 5-tree cluster (G-0415, G-0416, G-0421, G-0414, G-0418) within 83m of each other, roughly 1.3km south of the published Den Bosch trees, well clear of a 40-minute window. Would be a genuine second walk per cluster doctrine, but three Quercus robur oaks (this, G-0416, G-0421) sit within meters of one another, exactly the confusability risk this pass exists to fix for dbo_002, and doing it justice needs a dedicated pass with real time to distinguish them (girth, position, aerial imagery), not a rushed add-on. Not verified this pass; count/time failure, not an evidence failure.
